First public release of **Cadence**: local meeting transcription for macOS that knows who said what.

> The app's interface is **German only** for now. Transcription supports German, English and auto-detect.

### Highlights
- 🎙️ Records the meeting app's audio and your microphone as **two separate tracks**, with no bot in the call and no screen recording.
- 📝 **On-device transcription** with WhisperKit (Large v3 Turbo), live during the call.
- 👥 **Prepare participants** per party before the meeting (own company, customer, partners) or use the internal-meeting template.
- 🗣️ **Tag speakers live** by click or global hotkeys **⌃⌥1–9**, and assign unknown turns with one click.
- 🧠 **Speaker diarization** after the call (SpeakerKit/pyannote, on-device) spreads your tags over the whole conversation.
- 🔊 **Voice profiles**: assigned voices are remembered locally and recognized automatically in later meetings.
- ⭐️ Markers for highlights, to-dos and decisions, plus a **consent reminder** that is logged in the minutes.
- 📋 **Copy** with or without speakers and timestamps. **Export** as Markdown, meeting minutes, JSON, SRT or text.

### Install
1. Download **Cadence.zip** below and move `Cadence.app` to *Applications*.
2. The app is **not notarized**. On first launch, right-click → **Open**, or allow it under *System Settings → Privacy & Security*. You can also run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Cadence.app`.
3. Requires **macOS 14.4+**. Apple Silicon is recommended. The speech model (~1.6 GB) is downloaded once on first launch.

`Cadence.zip` is built by GitHub Actions from this tag (ad-hoc signed).
